release_notes: Fix release: the Telegram bot could never receive a message on a fresh install. The panel built its webhook URL from the current request's headers, and the installer hands out http://<server-ip>/admin.php — Telegram only calls a webhook back over HTTPS on a real domain, so setWebhook was refused every time and /start reached nothing, while the panel reported both "bot connected" and "connection error". Adds a polling mode (telegram_poll_cron.php) that asks Telegram for updates instead, so the bot works on a bare IP, over plain HTTP and behind a proxy; fixes scheme detection to honour X-Forwarded-Proto so proxied HTTPS installs stop building http:// webhook URLs; and shows the real reason on screen — the mode in use, Telegram's own error text, and when the poller last ran.
